name: Private Eye Cyclops crossword No 718
preamble: Running clockwise around the shaded squares, starting top left, is an extract (with a minor change) from our regular feature, Nursery Times in 2021. [Hint: it has a minor theme]. The 52 letters of this entry not crossing with normal solutions are: AA BBB CCC DD EEEEEEE G HHH II K LL M NNN OOO P RRRRR SSS TTTT UU V W YY

solutions.check: 76 entries verified against the grid image (lengths, crossings, linked-clue mapping); the unclued ring is unsolved: no quotation in the post fits it
